lines.zh: 四只脚踩在草地上，很稳
lines.en: Four feet on the grass, very steady

lines.zh: 头盾在前面，像一面骨墙
lines.en: My frill leads like a wall of bone

lines.zh: 我低着头走，角冲着前面
lines.en: I walk head low, horns forward

lines.zh: 平原上的草到我的膝盖
lines.en: The plains grass reaches my knees
I press across the meadow step by step

lines.zh: 阳光下我的头盾有一块亮斑
lines.en: A bright patch on my frill in the sun

lines.zh: 花田里的花被我踩倒一片
lines.en: I flatten a swath of flowers as I pass

lines.zh: 角根有点痒，我蹭了蹭树
lines.en: My horn base itches, I rub a tree
I am heavy, turning takes a wide arc

lines.zh: 我走在队伍边上，护着小的
lines.en: I walk at the herd's edge, guarding the young

lines.zh: 脚印很深，土都被压平了
lines.en: My prints are deep, the soil pressed flat
When the wind comes, I lift my head to listen
I go around the rocks, no need to crash through

lines.zh: 草地上一队影子，慢慢挪
lines.en: A row of shadows crosses the meadow slowly
My tail flicks to drive off flies

lines.zh: 林子边上我停下来，看看树
lines.en: I stop at the forest edge and study the trees
I stand with my horns pointed at the grass

lines.zh: 头盾遮住了我大半视线
lines.en: My frill blocks most of my view
I graze with my head down, chewing slowly

lines.zh: 狮子靠近时，我会转过来
lines.en: When a lion comes near, I turn to face it
The sun is warm, I do not move
My breath stirs the grass

lines.zh: 脚下草被啃出一个小圈
lines.en: A small ring of grass is cropped at my feet

lines.zh: 我抬头，鼻子里喷了口气
lines.en: I lift my head and snort
A leaf is caught on my horn
There are bees by the flowers, I ignore them
I stand like this a long while
I lift a foot and set it down

lines.zh: 身上有点痒，我蹭了蹭角
lines.en: Something itches, I rub with my horn

lines.zh: 远处有兽群，我看看就去
lines.en: There is a herd far off, I will look and go
You are standing in front of my horns

lines.zh: 我把头低了一点，角对着你
lines.en: I lower my head, horns aimed at you
You are shorter than my frill
This body of mine does not fear a collision
There are not many people on these plains

lines.zh: 我侧过头，用一只眼看你
lines.en: I turn my head and look with one eye
I snort a breath out
Do not put your hand on my horns
I step back and give you room
If you are going, go quickly
I snort and take one step back
A mark on my frill
I lower my head, horns toward the wound
I bellow once, deep
I paw the ground to steady myself
Thick hide, and it still hurts
I do not like being driven to the edge
A patch of blood on the grass
I have remembered you for that
What you hold is grass
I put my head over and sniff
That handful is not one mouthful for me
I chewed it, the taste is ordinary
Step back and I will eat in peace

lines.zh: 我吃东西的时候不看你
lines.en: I do not watch you while I eat
This much grass is gone in a moment
Just put the grass down
I eat leaves, and flowers too

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我先晃了一下
lines.en: You charged and I rocked first
My horn nearly caught you
You hit my frill

lines.zh: 我站着，脚下土被压低了
lines.en: I stood, and the soil pressed lower

lines.zh: 别贴着我走，我头盾很宽
lines.en: Do not walk against me, my frill is wide
I turn and you must give way
That turned over a patch of grass

lines.zh: 我不主动顶人，可我会站住
lines.en: I do not charge first, but I hold my ground
Bump again and I lower my head

lines.zh: 这个季节，平原上同类不少
lines.en: This season there are many of my kind here

lines.zh: 我头上这面盾，是为了显眼
lines.en: This frill on my head is meant to be seen
Long horns, but no bad temper

lines.zh: 你站得太近，我转头就撞到了
lines.en: Standing that close, I could knock you just turning

lines.zh: 我要先看看你能不能吃草
lines.en: Let me see whether you can graze
The meadow is quiet, good for talking
I take a step, you take a step
Good grass here, water close by

lines.zh: 一队里，我这样的不算多
lines.en: There are not many like me in the herd

lines.zh: 天要黑了，我回队里去了
lines.en: It is getting dark, I am going back to the herd
I lower my head and the horn nearly spears it
This is not like grass
I spat it out and shook my head
It landed on my horn and hangs there
I step on it and it shatters
I sniff, it is not food
You pick it up, my horns are clumsy
Won't hang on my horn. Too soft.
I see something ahead
I lower my head half an inch
I know these plains

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，我不喜欢
lines.en: I do not care for your smell

lines.zh: 我把身子横过来，挡住路
lines.en: I turn broadside to block the way

lines.zh: 角尖朝前，这姿势就够了
lines.en: Horns forward, that pose is enough
The young are behind me, I do not retreat
The grass under me goes silent
My feet are restless, pawing the ground
Come near and I turn to face you
There is no cover on the plains
I settle my frill straight
I follow step by step, heavily

lines.zh: 你跑不过我，我能一直走
lines.en: You cannot outlast me, I can walk forever

lines.zh: 身后的兽群在叫，我不回头
lines.en: The herd is calling behind me, I do not turn
The grassland is open, you cannot get far
I turn slowly, but I need not turn
Your steps make noise in the grass
I press forward and the grass all falls
There is no rock in this meadow
My breathing is heavy, you can hear it
I stay pointed at you

lines.zh: 我压低了头，影子拖得很长
lines.en: I lower my head and my shadow stretches long

lines.zh: 角顶过去，你被挑起来了
lines.en: My horns come up and lift you

lines.zh: 我低头撞，脚下草皮翻开
lines.en: I lower my head and charge, the turf peels

lines.zh: 这一下顶在你的护甲上
lines.en: That landed on your armor
I shove you aside with my frill
My forefoot comes down and the soil sinks
You are driven back several steps
One shake of my head and you lose your grip
That charge used all my weight
You move off, and I stay put
A horn tip passed your shoulder
I stop, my feet still pawing

lines.zh: 你还站着，那我再来一次
lines.en: You are still up, so I come again

lines.zh: 平原上多了个带盾的影子
lines.en: A frilled shape has joined the plains
I come walking from the flower fields
My frill is bright in the sun
A path has been pressed into the grass

lines.zh: 我落地的时候，四脚一起
lines.en: I landed on all four feet together

lines.zh: 花田里的花倒了一小片
lines.en: A small patch of flowers is flattened
I raise my head and check the sun
One has stepped out at the forest edge
A low call carries from far off
This grass is just right
The sun is warm on my back
I walk slowly into the middle of the meadow
A fresh ring of prints under my feet

lines.zh: 火烧到草，也烧到我的腿
lines.en: Fire caught the grass and my legs

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，头盾磕在地上
lines.en: I rolled down the slope, frill striking the ground
The water is deep and my body is heavy
An arrow is stuck in my frill

lines.zh: 那股劲儿钻进骨头，很沉
lines.en: The force sank into my bones, heavy
This meadow has been grazed bare

lines.zh: 雷落在我角上，麻到脖子
lines.en: Lightning struck my horn and numbed my neck

lines.zh: 这里没有草，脚也没处踩
lines.en: No grass here, and nowhere to set my feet
